correctness.rationale: Direct three-step substitution yields the exact logarithmic dose curve and derivative. Independent symbolic differentiation confirms that derivative and the cubic minimizer identity. Strict concavity of the dose-derivative function, negative endpoint values, a unique minimum of the threshold function, and monotone decay of the exposure variable establish all equality and two-extremum regimes for every positive model parameter. The exact logarithmic-dose witness shows more third-generation hosts even as the first two generations decrease; 5,000 randomized recurrence checks and 48 threshold tests supplement the proof.
